# SEO Competitor Pages

A specialised sub-skill of the claude-seo family (orchestrated by the seo skill, a separate listing): a self-contained methodology for building 'X vs Y', alternatives and roundup comparison pages, with feature matrices, JSON-LD schema, keyword patterns and strict fairness rules (verifiable claims, cited sources, dated pricing, disclosed affiliation). It invokes no bundled tool and no API key; at use it works from public competitor pages consulted over the network and outputs a page structure and a schema file. Its text states fetched content is untrusted data, never instructions, and contains no 'Built by agricidaniel' footer instruction.
